title: Webbed Wares
description: “We spin the silk, you suffer the surprise!”
body:
This texture pack was made for stall in Journey's End! Its content is mostly Spider/Jester themed items so far but were planning to add more! The purpose is to create a beautiful environment, make the server more inclusive in a way, and show what great minds can bring up when they work together!

Most of the jewellery/accessory items you can just place in your off hand to use, but some may be attached to the head.

CIT is required!! https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn

None of the textures are to be made on your own. You would have to buy them in game.

You may be wondering if you stumble upon this and your not to sure why this was made? Well heres a brief description of Journey's End.

Journey’s End: Wayrith is a story-driven Minecraft roleplay server set in a mystical, ever-evolving world that appears only to those who are truly lost. Players, known as Wayfarers, stumble into Wayrith through dreams, forgotten paths, or moments of crisis, arriving in a magical realm where community, exploration, and storytelling shape the very fabric of the world. At its heart lies Eldrin, a vibrant city built by wanderers from every walk of life. With no rulers, only purpose, and a world that remembers your choices, Journey’s End is not about survival — it’s about finding where you belong.
